description: Show the MemGPT-style tier distribution (hot / recall / archival) of currently-valid, top-level memories and list the hot working set. Tiers are derived from access recency + frequency — hot = frequently or recently accessed, archival = old and rarely touched, recall = everything in between. Read-only; optional scope/namespace filter.

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

name: memory_tiers
